remarks: A masterful blend of timeless elegance and refined modern living, this exceptional North Stamford estate is privately set on a picturesque property surrounded by lush natural beauty. Thoughtfully designed for both grand-scale entertaining and everyday luxury, the residence showcases exquisite craftsmanship, soaring ceilings, expansive light-filled interiors, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. At the heart of the home, a spectacular chef's kitchen is anchored by a dramatic waterfall-edge granite island, premium appliances and a luxury lighted bar. Transition into an elegant formal dining room and an impressive great room/theatre for unforgettable gatherings. A beautifully appointed mahogany executive office provides an inspiring work-from-home setting. The main floor is completed by a stunning formal living room and a marvelous study/sun room. The luxurious primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a beverage bar, a custom dressing gallery, and a spa-inspired bath designed for ultimate relaxation. The home's beautifully finished lower level offers a private guest suite - perfect accommodations for extended family, guests, or live-in support. Thoughtfully designed lifestyle spaces - a private wellness studio, playroom, and sauna - add comfort and versatility. Outside, resort-inspired grounds and a huge deck offer an extraordinary setting for entertaining and peaceful retreat, where manicured landscaping and mature trees create exceptional privacy in every season.
